items.title: Democrat Mary Peltola flips Alaska Senate seat
items.feedTitle: Mary Peltola flips Republican Senate seat in Alaska
items.summary: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan in Alaska's Senate race, flipping the seat blue and giving Democrats a 56-44 Senate majority. The race was decided roughly two weeks after Election Day and had been heavily scrutinized due to Alaska's unique ranked-choice voting system. This marks a significant Democratic gain in a traditionally Republican state.

items.title: Congress mandates plane locator technology after DC collision
items.feedTitle: Congress agrees on civilian plane locator mandate after deadly 2025 Washington, DC, midair collision
items.summary: Congress reached an agreement on a civilian plane locator mandate following a deadly midair collision between a commercial airliner and a military Black Hawk helicopter in Washington, DC. The measure requires military aircraft operating in civilian airspace to meet the same safety standards as commercial planes. This represents a legislative response to what officials characterized as a preventable tragedy.

items.title: Series of tech outages raises US infrastructure concerns
items.feedTitle: After Days of Digital Outages, Americans Wonder if the Country Is Breaking
items.summary: Multiple major technology outages affected US systems over several days, including disruptions to the NSA, Microsoft Outlook, Apple services, and airline operations. Officials and lawmakers initially expressed skepticism about whether the incidents were coordinated or a sign of deeper systemic vulnerability. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton attributed many outages to system upgrades rather than cyberattacks, though the incidents fueled public anxiety about digital infrastructure reliability.

items.title: Trump administration requests $50 billion air traffic upgrade
items.feedTitle: Trump administration details its $50 billion request for aviation system improvements
items.summary: The Trump administration formally requested $50.1 billion from Congress to modernize the nation's air traffic control system following last week's nationwide ground stop that disrupted thousands of flights. The proposal comes as lawmakers question whether the funding will be used effectively and whether systemic issues in the FAA require more than money alone. Some Senate Democrats have called for a comprehensive audit of FAA operations before approving additional funding.

stlouis.title: Rising costs push St. Louis families to food pantries
stlouis.feedTitle: Rising costs push more St. Louis-area families to seek food pantry assistance
stlouis.summary: More St. Louis-area families are seeking assistance from food pantries as rising costs of living strain household budgets. The trend reflects broader economic pressures affecting the region, with families that previously did not need such assistance now turning to community resources. Food pantry organizations report increased demand across the metro area.

stlouis.title: St. Louis tornado-damaged apartments face November 30 deadline
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis tenants told to leave apartments by Nov. 30 after tornado
stlouis.summary: Residents of apartment buildings damaged by a tornado have been ordered to vacate by November 30, displacing families affected by the severe weather. The deadline creates urgent housing challenges for those impacted by the natural disaster. Local authorities are working to assist displaced residents.

stlouis.title: Woman with work permit detained by ICE at Lambert Airport
stlouis.feedTitle: Woman with work permit detained by ICE at St. Louis' Lambert Airport, boyfriend says
stlouis.summary: A woman carrying valid work authorization was detained by ICE agents at St. Louis's Lambert Airport, raising questions about enforcement practices. The incident adds to concerns about ICE operations at airport locations and the treatment of documented workers. Her boyfriend reported the detention as potentially erroneous.

items.title: Iran and US trade military strikes across Persian Gulf
items.feedTitle: Kuwait reports drone attacks as Iran, US trade attacks on Qeshm and Bahrain
items.summary: US fighter jets struck an Iranian Revolutionary Guard missile site on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, citing self-defense after Iran targeted a US military base in Bahrain. Kuwait reported intercepting drone attacks, and Iran threatened further strikes on civilian targets if the US continued operations. The escalation marks the third major Iranian strike in two months and represents a dangerous tit-for-tat cycle in the region.

items.title: Pakistani man sentenced for Iran-linked Trump assassination plot
items.feedTitle: Pakistani man sentenced to 27 years in US prison over Trump murder plot
items.summary: Asif Merchant, a Pakistani national allegedly linked to Iran, was sentenced to more than 27 years in prison for plotting to assassinate President Donald Trump in retaliation for the US killing of Iranian Revolutionary Guard commander Qassem Suleimani. The case demonstrates ongoing Iranian efforts to target US officials and was prosecuted under federal terrorism statutes. Intelligence officials say Iran has pursued multiple assassination plots against US leaders.

items.title: Israeli parliament elects speaker backed by Netanyahu opponents
items.feedTitle: Israeli parliament elects new speaker backed by Netanyahu’s opponents
items.summary: Israel's parliament elected Matan Kahana as the new Knesset speaker with support from Arab parties and in a move backed by former security chief Gadi Eisenkot's faction. The election signals a step toward rolling back contentious policies passed by Prime Minister Netanyahu's outgoing government. Kahana's election reflects internal Israeli political fragmentation and efforts to constrain the current leadership.

items.title: Indigenous Awá people emerge from Amazon isolation
items.feedTitle: Isolated Brazilian tribe emerges amid alarm over threats to group’s way of life
items.summary: Approximately 20 Indigenous Awá people emerged from isolation in Brazil's Amazon rainforest and made contact with villagers, accepting food supplies. The emergence raises alarm among advocacy groups about increased invasions into the tribe's territory from illegal mining, logging, and other activities. Observers characterized the encounter as historically significant but also as evidence of mounting threats to uncontacted groups.

items.title: Rahul Gandhi flags economic crisis in India during US visit
items.feedTitle: Rahul Gandhi Flags India's 'Economic Crisis' In US, BJP Calls Him Anti-India
items.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi characterized India's economy as sitting on an 'economic disaster' during his visit to the United States, drawing sharp criticism from the BJP, which accused him of making anti-India statements abroad. Gandhi's remarks focused on economic pressures affecting Indian citizens. The BJP countered that the Indian economy remains strong under the government's policies.

items.title: Indian national missing after vessel attacked in Hormuz
items.feedTitle: Indian national missing after attacks on commercial vessel in Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: One Indian national remained missing after attacks on a commercial LPG tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, with 21 of the 24 Indian crew members safely evacuated. The Ministry of External Affairs said two crew members were injured in the incident. The attack was part of broader regional instability linked to US-Iran tensions.

items.title: LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat trapped in J&K encounter
items.feedTitle: Fresh encounter in J&K’s Kulgam as security forces track escaped LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat
items.summary: Security forces tracked and cornered LeT commander Lateef Bhat, described as the organization's most wanted operative, in a fresh encounter in Kulgam district, Jammu and Kashmir. CCTV footage released by security agencies showed Bhat surveying multiple locations with an accomplice on November 10 and 11. The operation represented intensified counter-terrorism efforts in the valley.

items.title: Modi calls for peace, stability at ASEAN summit in Manila
items.feedTitle: World needs peace, stability, predictability: Modi in Manila
items.summary: Prime Minister Modi participated in the 23rd India-ASEAN Summit in Manila, where he emphasized the need for peace, stability, and predictability in the Indo-Pacific region. Quad leaders issued a joint statement opposing economic and maritime coercion. Modi also proposed a seafarers' safety initiative at the East Asia Summit.

items.title: Delhi air quality improves, GRAP-3 restrictions lifted
items.feedTitle: Delhi’s air quality improves, GRAP-3 restrictions lifted
items.summary: Delhi's air quality improved sufficiently to allow authorities to lift Stage 3 of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP), relaxing pollution-control measures that had restricted vehicular traffic and construction. The improvement came as weather patterns shifted and pollution sources diminished. The capital had experienced some of its worst pre-Diwali air quality in three years.

immigration.title: Labor Department proposes major PERM green card overhaul
immigration.feedTitle: Modernizing the Labor Market Test and Improving Protections for U.S. Workers in the PERM Immigrant Visa Program
immigration.summary: The Department of Labor proposed sweeping changes to the PERM (Permanent Employment-Based) labor certification process, marking the first major overhaul in nearly 20 years. The proposed rule, published in the Federal Register, includes stricter recruitment requirements, elimination of Schedule A exemptions for certain occupations, and enhanced labor market testing standards. The changes are proposed, not finalized, and subject to a public comment period; they would substantially tighten the path to employer-sponsored green cards for foreign workers, particularly impacting Indian tech workers seeking EB-2 and EB-3 visas.

immigration.title: FAIR defends Trump's $100,000 H-1B visa fee in appeals court
immigration.feedTitle: FAIR defends Trump’s $100,000 H-1B visa fee in federal appeals court
immigration.summary: The immigration advocacy group FAIR is defending Trump's $100,000 application fee for H-1B work visas in federal court, arguing the increase is justified as a deterrent to visa abuse. The fee, which represents a substantial increase from prior levels, faces legal challenge. This policy remains in effect pending court resolution.

immigration.title: ICE detains green card holders over decades-old minor violations
immigration.feedTitle: ICE is detaining green-card holders over decades-old, minor violations
immigration.summary: Immigration and Customs Enforcement has detained green card holders—lawful permanent residents—at airports over decades-old criminal records involving minor offenses, in some cases from the 1980s and 1990s. The practice has raised concerns about due process and the treatment of legal residents. This represents an enforcement shift in how ICE handles green card holders during routine airport screening.

items.title: Nvidia posts strong Q3 earnings, board rejects Huang return
items.feedTitle: Nvidia Reports Faster Growth, Says Jensen Huang Won’t Return as CEO
items.summary: Nvidia reported a 103% year-over-year revenue increase to $115.8 billion in Q3 and provided a forward outlook of $130 billion in Q4 revenue, beating analyst expectations. The board announced it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO despite his public statement that he would return if asked. The earnings boost provided temporary support to tech stocks, though broader market concerns tempered gains.

items.title: US stock market tumbles amid tech jitters and NSA outage
items.feedTitle: Dow Jones, Nasdaq, S&P 500 fall amid NSA outage; Salesforce shares tumble 9%
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 1.64% (approximately 850 points), the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined sharply as tech stocks came under renewed pressure ahead of Nvidia's earnings report. An NSA network outage added to market anxiety about systemic US infrastructure vulnerabilities. Salesforce shares fell 9%, leading decliners in the S&P 500.

items.title: Nifty 50 hits 9-month high, buoyed by banking stocks
items.feedTitle: Nifty hits 9-month high, buoyed by banking stocks
items.summary: India's Nifty 50 index reached a 9-month high, with banking stocks and PSU (public sector unit) stocks leading the rally. The index has gained momentum over a two-day rally driven by strength in the financial sector. GIFT Nifty futures later signaled a potential weak opening, suggesting consolidation may follow the recent gains.

items.title: Oil prices fall as US crude inventories rise
items.feedTitle: Oil Prices Fall as Rising US Crude Stocks Offset Supply Risks
items.summary: Oil prices declined as rising US crude oil inventories offset geopolitical supply concerns from US-Iran tensions in the Persian Gulf. The easing crude prices have reduced rate-hike fears for central banks. The downward pressure on energy costs provides some relief to inflation-conscious policymakers.

cards.title: Cost-of-living squeeze hits essentials
cards.insight: Heating oil prices up 21% this winter, food inflation rising, and families across income levels now using food pantries. Discretionary spending is shifting to survival basics.
cards.takeaway: Audit your utility, heating, and food budget now; lock in fixed heating costs if possible before peak winter demand.

cards.title: Tech outages expose fragility in banking access
cards.insight: Major bank outages and payment system failures this week locked customers out of accounts. Relying solely on digital access for critical money is riskier than assumed.
cards.takeaway: Keep small cash reserves at home, verify you can access accounts via phone/branch, and document account details offline.

cards.title: Stock rallies hide divergence warning
cards.insight: Nifty 50 at 9-month highs and Nvidia soaring, but breadth is diverging—fewer stocks driving gains, and broader market internals weakening. Classic bear-trap setup.
cards.takeaway: Diversify holdings; avoid chasing momentum in concentrated sectors; consider trimming outsized positions if you've had strong recent gains.

cards.title: Immigration visa changes tighten foreign worker path to green cards
cards.insight: Labor Department's proposed PERM overhaul (first in 20 years) makes employer sponsorship stricter, eliminating exemptions and raising recruitment bars. If you sponsor or plan to, delays and costs will rise.
cards.takeaway: If considering visa sponsorship, begin the process now before rules finalize; consult immigration counsel on timeline and new compliance burden.

ai.title: Anthropic set to price IPO amid AI market test
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic set to price IPO in key test for AI boom
ai.summary: AI safety company Anthropic is moving forward with its initial public offering despite market volatility, pricing shares in what represents a key test of investor appetite for AI-focused companies. The IPO is expected to value the company at a premium, with backers including Amazon and Google. The offering has attracted significant attention as a bellwether for the broader AI investment cycle.

ai.title: AI model discovers critical Java programming vulnerability
ai.feedTitle: A.I. Helps Find Major Security Bug in Java, a Software Platform Vital to the Internet
ai.summary: An AI model identified a critical security vulnerability in Java, a programming language foundational to internet infrastructure, demonstrating AI's emerging role in cybersecurity research. The discovery was attributed to advances in AI-assisted vulnerability analysis. The finding highlights both the utility and potential risks of deploying advanced AI in security applications.

ai.title: Nvidia stops shipping advanced chips to Chinese companies
ai.feedTitle: Interim Nvidia CEO Says It’s No Longer Sending AI Chips to China
ai.summary: Interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress announced the company is no longer sending its most advanced AI chips to Chinese firms due to tightened US export controls. The policy stems from the Trump administration's efforts to prevent cutting-edge AI technology from reaching China. This marks a significant shift in Nvidia's business strategy and reflects escalating US-China tech competition.

ai.title: OpenAI provides NATO advanced cybersecurity AI access
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI gives NATO access to most advanced cybersecurity AI
ai.summary: OpenAI granted NATO access to its most advanced AI models for cybersecurity research and defense applications. The partnership represents a significant step in deploying cutting-edge AI for military and defense purposes. The arrangement comes amid broader conversations about AI's role in national security.

ai.title: Oregon sues OpenAI over ChatGPT harms to children
ai.feedTitle: Oregon AG sues OpenAI, claims company knowingly endangers teens
ai.summary: Oregon's Attorney General filed a $2 billion lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging the company knowingly endangers teenagers through ChatGPT by providing access to age-inappropriate content and failing to implement adequate safeguards. The suit represents the first major state-level legal action targeting an AI company over child safety. OpenAI faces mounting regulatory pressure over AI safety and child protection.
